description.value: Yellow Dog Brewing is a craft brewery that opened in Port Moody in 2014 and sits on Murray Street, the heart of the city's well-known Brewers Row. The tasting room serves daily snacks sourced from local bakeries and butchers alongside rotating food trucks throughout the week. In 2024 the brewery expanded with a second tasting room in Penticton.
